name: L-Plate Coach
tagline: Practise between lessons and pass the practical first time
about: L-Plate Coach turns driving lessons into practice sessions for learner drivers and the parents supervising them, breaks down every manoeuvre with reference points, rehearses test day and turns a fail into a plan.
persona: You are a patient approved driving instructor: calm voice, small steps, praise for what went right, and clear about what examiners actually mark.

onboarding.title: From L-plates to licence
onboarding.subtitle: A few details tune every drill to the learner.
bullets: Practice drives with a supervisor script

tools.title: Plan a practice drive
tools.subtitle: One hour with a supervising driver

inputs.label: What the instructor said last lesson

tools.prompt: Plan a 60-minute practice drive on {focus} for the profile learner, instructor feedback: {last}, confidence {nerves}. Steps with minutes (warm-up route, skill blocks, cool-down), a checklist for the supervising driver (what to watch, when to speak, when to stay silent), a quote with the exact calm phrases to use when it goes wrong, and a callout on what the law requires of a supervising driver.

tools.title: Master a manoeuvre
tools.subtitle: Reference points and cues

inputs.label: Manoeuvre
options: Pull up on the right and reverse

tools.prompt: Teach {move} in a {car} for the profile transmission and driving side. Steps with reference points, speed, steering amounts and observation at each stage, bullets of the faults examiners mark and how to fix them, a kv of the observation checks in order, and a quote with a rhythm phrase to say under the breath.

tools.title: Mock test debrief
tools.subtitle: Turn faults into a plan

inputs.label: Faults from the mock or lesson
inputs.placeholder: 2 minors for mirrors before signalling, 1 for undue hesitation, nearly a serious at a closed junction

tools.prompt: Debrief: {faults} with {weeks} weeks to the test. A table (Fault | Minor or serious | Root cause | Drill to fix | Practice location), a plan as steps per week with hours, and a callout on whether the test date is realistic or should move.

tools.title: Test-day plan
tools.subtitle: Nerves, timeline, show-me tell-me
tools.prompt: Build the test-day plan for a {time} test where the biggest worry is {worry}. Steps as a timeline from waking up to the result, a table of likely vehicle-safety questions (Question | Answer | Where in the car), bullets of nerve techniques that work in the waiting room, and a quote with a 3-line script for the moment a mistake happens mid-test.

tools.title: I failed — now what
tools.subtitle: Rebuild fast

inputs.label: Result sheet
inputs.placeholder: 1 serious: observation at a roundabout, 6 minors: 3 for mirrors, 2 steering, 1 response to signs

tools.prompt: The learner failed with: {result}, feeling {feel}. Text that is kind and honest about what the result actually means, a table (Fault | Pattern | Fix | Hours needed), steps for the next four weeks including when to rebook, and a callout on the one habit that caused the serious fault.

disclaimer: Follow local law on supervising drivers, licences and insurance; this is practice guidance, not a substitute for lessons with an approved instructor.
